data.body: Decision overturned by landed change 1538 (Ia8b5fcb6fc89703390b2b1eb57d324f00436d59e; origin/main 11a026540b): bridge workflows no longer retain workflow-local CAS push loops. The reconciler delegates strict synchronous delivery to the core push action while preserving exact bot identity and commit subject; the canary delegates push-only best-effort delivery and remains red on persistent failure. Copied-template refresh, timing changes, and rollback continuity are documented. CI run 31241954882 passed all lanes; Gerrit recorded LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, and zero unresolved comments.
